name: Dhaka Summer Open A 2024

venue.name: [Orchid International School](https://orchidintschool.com/)

information:
This competition is part of the Dhaka Summer Open 2024 series. **You can participate in *ONLY ONE* competition in the series.**  

New participants have to bring a proof of identity that has the participant's Date of Birth.

Keep an eye on the [Speedcubing Bangladesh](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingBD) Facebook page to get updates.
